listitem.para: Whether &Libreswan; should support &rfc7427; and the SIGNATURE_HASH_ALGORITHMS notification.
Always send and parse the SIGNATURE_HASH_ALGORITHMS notification.
Never send, and always ignore, the SIGNATURE_HASH_ALGORITHMS notification.
Send the SIGNATURE_HASH_ALGORITHMS when the connection is using Digital Signatures (pubkeys). Always parse the SIGNATURE HASH_ALGORITHMS notification.
